title: SmartATPG: Learning-based Automatic Test Pattern Generation with Graph Convolutional Network and Reinforcement Learning
problem: Automatic test pattern generation (ATPG) for detecting circuit faults is NP-complete and generates excessive backtracking during search, degrading performance and search efficiency.
motivation: Effective fault detection in integrated circuits is critical to ensure chip yield and quality.
method: SmartATPG uses a graph convolutional network (GCN) to extract circuit feature information from the circuit graph structure, while reinforcement learning (RL) guides exploration through the ATPG search space. The RL agent learns to make decisions that minimize backtracking compared to traditional heuristic approaches.
key_novelty: Application of GCN for circuit feature extraction combined with RL-based guided search to reduce backtracking in ATPG.
contributions: SmartATPG framework combining GCN and RL for ATPG
Demonstrated superiority over traditional and ANN-based heuristic methods

metrics.accuracy: Outperforms traditional ATPG and ANN-based heuristics on benchmark circuits
